heading: Fact
text:
### Fact [IRET.4.3]

A fact carries its identity, its schema, two timestamps, its
truth-maintenance refcount, and its slot values:

| Field | Holds |
|---|---|
| id | monotonically assigned, **never reused** within a session ([IRET.4.4]) |
| schema | the schema this fact instantiates |
| assert_ns | the fact's entry stamp: the monotonic clock's sample when it entered working memory ([LTIM.2.8.6]) |
| deadline_ns | the expiry instant for a TTL fact; `0` means no deadline |
| justif_count | the number of active justifications; non-zero only on `logical` facts, and reaching zero is what retracts one ([IRET.4.5]) |
| slots | the values, one per slot the schema declares |

The slot values are stored **inline with the fact**, sized from the
schema's slot count, rather than behind a pointer — one allocation per
fact, and slot access is an offset rather than an indirection.

idris.name: Ltim_2_8_6__stamps
idris.note: The clause's `assert_ns` -- 'the monotonic clock's sample when it entered working memory' -- kept as a table from fact id to stamp rather than inline in the fact.

idris.name: iret_4_3__record_action_agree
idris.note: Both sides stamp the same deadline for one action.

idris.name: iret_4_3__record_action_net
idris.note: What one RHS action mints, on the network: an activation's fact ids are its token's.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__apply_sampled
idris.note: The clause's `assert_ns` is written at the data input, at the held monotonic sample, as Rete/EntryStamp.idr keeps it.

idris.name: Iret_4_3__deadlines
idris.note: The clause's `deadline_ns`, kept beside the engine as a table from fact id to deadline rather than inline in the fact; a fact without a row has no deadline (the clause's `0`).

idris.name: Iret_4_3__deadlines_ok
idris.note: THE TABLE'S INVARIANT: one row per id; every live TTL fact has its row; no other live fact has one; every live fact's deadline is after the clock.

idris.name: iret_4_3__clear
idris.note: Drop an id's rows.

idris.name: iret_4_3__clear_elem
idris.note: A row of the cleared table is a row of the table, of another id.

idris.name: iret_4_3__clear_keeps
idris.note: Rows of other ids survive a clear.

idris.name: iret_4_3__deadlines_core
idris.note: Through one core action the table stays well-formed: a withdraw mints nothing and only removes; an emit mints at most the fresh id with the emitted kind, by the action shape of Rete/TmsRun.idr.

idris.name: iret_4_3__deadlines_mint
idris.note: A mint keeps the table well-formed: the fresh id was not live, so its old rows belonged to no live fact, and the new fact's row, if any, is in the future.

idris.name: iret_4_3__deadlines_sub
idris.note: Fewer facts, same table: still well-formed.

idris.name: iret_4_3__emit_inj
idris.note: `Emit` is injective.

idris.name: iret_4_3__init
idris.note: The input's table: every input fact of a TTL kind, asserted at the start clock.

idris.name: iret_4_3__init_ok
idris.note: The input's table is well-formed, given unique ids.

idris.name: iret_4_3__lt_ttl
idris.note: A non-zero TTL puts the deadline strictly after the clock.

idris.name: iret_4_3__record_action
idris.note: What one RHS action mints: an emit stamps the fresh id [LFAC.2.5.3] with the clock the firing read; a withdraw stamps nothing.

idris.name: iret_4_3__row
idris.note: An input fact's row: none for a kind without a TTL.

idris.name: iret_4_3__row_for
idris.note: An input fact of a TTL kind has its row.

idris.name: iret_4_3__row_of
idris.note: What a row of the input's table says of its fact: its id, its deadline, its kind's TTL non-zero.

idris.name: iret_4_3__stamp
idris.note: Record a fresh fact's deadline: `assert_ns` plus the kind's TTL, with the id's stale rows dropped first. The model's fresh id is the smallest free one, not the clause's never-reused id; the clear makes the table right under reuse, and is a no-op when ids are never reused.

idris.name: iret_4_3__stamp_elem
idris.note: A row of the stamped table is an untouched row of another id, or the new row: the fresh id, the clock plus the kind's non-zero TTL.

idris.name: iret_4_3__stamp_keeps
idris.note: Rows of other ids survive a stamp.

idris.name: iret_4_3__stamp_new
idris.note: Stamping a TTL kind adds its row.

idris.name: iret_4_3__stamp_unique
idris.note: A stamp keeps one row per id.

idris.name: iret_4_3__withdraw_not_emit
idris.note: `Withdraw` is not `Emit`.
